document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The two of you walk, hungry, for many days. One morning you 
wake to find Norman gone. You search for the entire day but 
fail to turn up a single trace of him. In the end, you have to 
admit you are alone.
